subject.title: [Feature Request] Add tool call visibility to streamTo="parent" for ACP runtime

question: Should ACP `streamTo="parent"` expose child tool calls, tool results, and thought/progress internals to the parent session, and what default-off redaction and verbosity policy should govern that exposure?
rationale: The requested data can contain secrets, file paths, command output, tool payloads, and reasoning-like content, and it crosses child/parent session plus channel-delivery boundaries that automation should not define without maintainer/security intent.

options.title: Define Redacted Projection
options.body: Expose only bounded summaries through existing ACP/channel visibility policy, with raw arguments, raw results, and thought hidden by default and covered by focused tests and docs.

options.title: Keep Current Scope
options.body: Leave parent streams limited to assistant/commentary/status progress and continue directing detailed tool inspection to logs or richer session surfaces.

options.title: Add Raw Verbose Relay
options.body: Forward raw tool and thought data behind an explicit verbose switch, accepting a larger privacy and security review burden.

recommendation.title: Define Redacted Projection
recommendation.body: Expose only bounded summaries through existing ACP/channel visibility policy, with raw arguments, raw results, and thought hidden by default and covered by focused tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and merged the most recent hardening/config work on the ACP parent relay visibility surface.
